detail.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: The notebook revision provides a stronger bridge between system-level uncertainty (a measurable output) and the project's goal of identifying inadequate axioms.

detail.title: Path-Dependent Preference Formation

detail.reason: Maintaining active status on path-dependent preference formation.
